mainEntity.name: How can I maintain my gate to prevent future repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular maintenance is crucial for prolonging the life of your gate and preventing costly repairs. This includes routinely lubricating moving parts, checking for loose hardware, cleaning tracks and sensors, and inspecting the gate for signs of wear or damage. Addressing small issues promptly can prevent them from escalating. For homeowners and businesses in Berkeley and the surrounding East Bay, Frasheski Construction recommends scheduling periodic professional inspections to ensure all components are functioning correctly and to identify potential problems early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular maintenance like lubricating parts, checking hardware, and cleaning tracks prevents future gate repairs. Periodic professional inspections are also recommended.
